svg.title: One request has one token budget
svg.desc: A slotted input tray and a segmented budget holder. Token counts depend on the tokenizer. Word counts cannot establish context limits.
svg.text: One request has one token budget
The example text is "unbelievable agents!". Characters and words are not the unit
An illustrative split is [un] [believ] [able] [ agents] [!], with IDs 41, 9021,
73, 1884, and 9. Real splits vary by tokenizer.
Instructions, goal, history, retrieved evidence, and tool results share the
Leave capacity for generated output under the model’s actual context and output
limits. The tray is schematic, not a token-capacity scale.
Token counts depend on the tokenizer. Word counts cannot establish context limits.
